blocks.text: PARIS, France—Pope Leo XIV rode down the French capital’s iconic Champs-Elysees avenue in his popemobile on Saturday to the cheers of huge crowds of faithful, ahead of a giant open-air mass. Aboard the popemobile, the smiling pontiff blessed several babies and waved to worshippers, as he made his way from the Arc de Triomphe to Place de la Concorde, where a giant white canopy was installed. Dozens of giant screens lined the more than two-kilometer stretch.
